page.layout: Running head at top: page number 244 at left, "NOTÆ." at centre. One column of running text, with a note in the left margin beside the middle of the column. Arabic lines are set inline within the Latin text. Catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.p: creat eas in rebus inanimatis ; & attribui ipsi opera per Metaphoram, ut cùm attribuuntur inanimatis ; sicut dicitur, Fructum facit arbor, & currit aqua, & movetur lapis, &c. esse etiam praemium & poenam ex iis quae ex necessitate proveniunt, imò cùm statuatur coactio, sen necessitas, esse etiam mandatorum impositionem ex ne-cessitate. Hæc Sharestanius. Idem testatur, & AlMo-tarreki, qui affirmare illos ait, [illegible, ~12 letters] [illegible, ~30 letters] [illegible, ~18 letters] Non esse actionem re-verà cuipiam praeter Deum ; homines autem in iis quae ipsis attribuuntur actionibus, se habere instar arboris quam movet ventus, &c. unde & apud EbnolKassai hæc hujus sectæ descriptio [illegible, ~40 letters] [illegible, ~30 letters] [illegible, ~30 letters] v.Sharest.? & EbnolKaffai. AlJabmiani Socii sunt Jabmi Ebn Sefwan, qui dicunt nullam esse omnino homini potentiam neque operantem, neque acquirentem ; sed esse eum eodem gradu quo inanimata ; nec non futurum ut Paradisus & ignis [Gehennæ] evanescant, postquam ingressi fuerint in eos qui iis digni, donec tandem non maneat existens quicquam praeter Deum. Tertia demum sententia est Alfabariorum mediorum, sive moderatiorum, quales, AlNajariani & AlDarariani, nec non juxta Authorem AlMawakef & EbnolKassai (ut diximus) AlAf.

page.notes: The Arabic lines inside the text (after "qui affirmare illos ait", after "re-", after "hujus sectae descriptio", and the two lines ending in "sunt"/"AlJabmiani") are not transcribed letter by letter; each is marked illegible with an approximate letter count. The margin note reads "v.Shareft." on the scan; "Shareft" is uncertain and is marked [?]. The note is placed beside the line "AlJabmiani Socii". Bracketed "[Gehennæ]" is printed in the text. The "AlAf." at the foot is the catchword for the next page. No signature or running-head numbers are printed beyond "244" and "NOTÆ.".
